NONE: › to be so extreme that it is difficult to believe
若非親眼所見，否則真難以置信

example: The prices in that place have to be seen to be believed!
那裡東西的價格如果不是親眼所見真難以置信！

NONE: › If something is calling you, you have a strong feeling that you must do it, have it, go there, etc.

example: That last piece of chocolate cake is calling me.
那塊僅剩的巧克力蛋糕正對著我發出陣陣誘惑。

NONE: › If someone has a quality that knows no bounds, it is extreme.
（某人的某特質）沒有限量，無限
